title: The Last Border
author: Noor Thackeray
blurb: Beatrix Yarrow, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
